scope: Finite read-only visual/source audit; no runtime redesign, Android filesystem API or production/a11y signoff. Coverage of every tracked page template includes redirects and a staged standalone stream layout. Conditional dialogs and roles have explicit gaps.

contrastTokenRatios.method: WCAG relative luminance from actual computed opaque HSL tokens; not full DOM/composited glass verification

scrollReturn.method: Actual wheel, sidebar navigation and browser Back

coldLogin.source: Installed UI4b/API969, ordinary Chrome, initial GET http://127.0.0.1:3015/login before credentials
coldLogin.scope: One Navigation Timing readback; attribution and repeated distribution not established

coverageGaps: Real phone soft keyboard and OS/browser chrome
Conditional account/session/VPN/schedule records not created for this read-only pass
Live streaming, fullscreen frame and Android input not re-tested; four layout/quality screens deliberately block only the owned stream socket
Offscreen controls, native browser color/file pickers and every dynamic modal variant are not claimed visually observed
Long names, large production datasets, every theme/accent combination and full WCAG/axe audit are not accepted
